recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-3506 unless Patient Administration later changes the semantics or naming of Location.managingOrganization search.
issue_request: FHIR-3506 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request for DSTU1 stating that Location lacked a managingOrganization search parameter, preventing clients from locating Locations managed by a specified Organization. PA recorded the decision on 2014-10-13 to apply the request as described.
initial_application: Git commit 8ea4fd388984d6975df0bc0151ac1b36a5fbc201, "Task #3506 Added organization to the list of search fields available by default," added an organization search row with description, reference type, and expression Location.managingOrganization to source/location/location-spreadsheet.xml. Later source conversions and the R4B/core rework preserved that search parameter in the current Location search-parameter bundle.
additional_context: Location is an active current-build resource via source/fhir.ini, and the current Location definition contains Location.managingOrganization as a Reference to Organization. The current Location search-parameter bundle defines Location-organization with code organization, type reference, expression Location.managingOrganization, and the description "Searches for locations that are managed by the provided organization." Related Jira/community searches did not identify a later decision reversing or narrowing this Location search parameter; FHIR-10462 appeared only as a separate Encounter.serviceProvider search-parameter issue and was not decided.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative current source already implements the requested Location organization search parameter in the active Location resource.

related_jiras.note: A broad Jira search-parameter query also returned this PA issue, but it concerns Encounter.serviceProvider rather than Location.managingOrganization and was not decided here.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive PA change request stating that Location lacked a managingOrganization search parameter and should be searchable by managing organization.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final request to expose a Location search parameter over Location.managingOrganization.

evidence_items.summary: The 2014-10-13 Task #3506 commit added an organization search row with reference type and expression Location.managingOrganization to the Location spreadsheet.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was explicitly applied in source history before later source-format refactors.
The Location resource and its source-local artifacts are part of the current core build scope.

evidence_items.summary: Location.managingOrganization is defined as the organization responsible for provisioning and upkeep and is typed Reference(Organization).
